ledger_authority: ACP Internal Accounting Core after accepted cutover

policies.fixed_rule: Use exactly the active QuickBooks company functional/home currency at cutover; Day 1 is single-functional-currency.
evidence_required: QuickBooks company settings export or controlled screenshot
cutover trial balance showing currency/basis settings

policies.fixed_rule: Match the current QuickBooks book basis exactly; do not change basis during migration.
evidence_required: trial balance, balance sheet, and P&L exported with the same basis and cutoff

policies.fixed_rule: Company business and cutover date boundaries use America/New_York; transport timestamps remain offset-aware.
evidence_required: QuickBooks export metadata must record its source timezone for migration reconciliation

policies.fixed_rule: ACP periods must reproduce the active QuickBooks fiscal year/calendar at cutover; periods cannot overlap.
Adopt the active QuickBooks Chart of Accounts without redesign and preserve source types/classifications and stable identities.
evidence_required: stable source account IDs, types, subtypes, active state, and parent relationships

policies.fixed_rule: Every active/nonzero account maps exactly once to a versioned balance-sheet or income-statement section consistent with its accepted COA classification.
evidence_required: current QuickBooks balance sheet and P&L account ordering
blocks: ACC.RPT.1 balance sheet and P&L acceptance

policies.fixed_rule: Opening retained earnings equals evidenced QuickBooks retained earnings; reports present unclosed current earnings separately and never invent a closing entry.
Buckets are versioned, ordered, nonoverlapping, exhaustive, and based on contractual due date in America/New_York.
evidence_required: QuickBooks AR aging settings and report

policies.fixed_rule: Buckets are versioned, ordered, nonoverlapping, exhaustive, and based on due date in America/New_York.
evidence_required: QuickBooks AP aging settings and report

policies.fixed_rule: Canonical ledger math remains debit-positive; presentation signs may not alter balances or reconciliation.
Every comparison is a separately complete computation with its own effective range and cutoff.
evidence_required: Finance confirmation that fiscal/calendar comparisons are valid

policies.fixed_rule: A report is current only for its immutable ledger/subledger cutoffs; any later authoritative posting or open-item evidence makes the prior result stale. No elapsed-time SLA can override cutoff inconsistency.
Accepted report packages and manifests are immutable, access-controlled, and retained under an approved accounting/legal records schedule.

policies.approved_fact: Owner as FINANCE_PREPARER; external accountant/CPA as INDEPENDENT_FINANCE_APPROVER; Owner as final cutover authority
policies.fixed_rule: Preparer/reconciler and independent approver are different human identities; unresolved or nonzero variances block acceptance.
evidence_required: named human assignments are recorded separately under independent_reviewer_identity

policies.fixed_rule: Every required control ties exactly to its authoritative subledger or signed workpaper at the same company, currency, basis, and cutoff; absence is not zero.
evidence_required: tax, inventory, payroll, opening-state, equity, and every applicable conditional schedule

policies.fixed_rule: The external accountant/CPA is the independent approver and may approve a checksum-bound package without ACP application access; their identity must differ from the preparer.
evidence_required: reviewer legal/display identity and professional relationship
availability for rehearsal and cutover gates

reconciliation_invariants: trial balance debits equal credits and net equals zero
assets equal liabilities plus equity including current earnings
AR open items equal AR subledger equal AR control
AP open items equal AP subledger equal AP control
bank and cash book balances equal mapped GL balances and reconciling items explain statement variance
every nonzero control variance is unresolved regardless of reporting materiality

consumers.ACC.POST.1: accepted currency, basis, periods, COA/control mappings and exact posting policy
consumers.ACC.RPT.1: all report definitions, mappings, aging, display, comparison, freshness, retention, review and reconciliation policy
consumers.ACC.MIG.1: source settings, accepted mappings, opening controls, artifact checksums, dispositions and independent approval evidence
consumers.cutover_reconciliation: same-company, same-currency, same-basis, same-cutoff exact control package
consumers.finance_review: immutable checksum-bound package with preparer, independent decision, exceptions and final owner authorization

activation_rule: No unresolved parameter is replaced by a recommendation or default. Every blocking policy must carry accepted evidence before its consumer activates.
